about: Every file the film draws from, in one folder (default dist/film/assets). stage.ts makes a stand-in for each from the Linkbox fixture and the POC cards. To use a real v1 capture, drop it in under the same name: stage keeps any file it did not make. Rects are CSS px of the captured page; PNGs are 2x.

assets.what: The PR's unified diff, drawn as an endless code review.
assets.stand_in: Every Linkbox change end to end: the first commit plus the four PR branches.
assets.real: git diff of the v1 demo PR (git diff main...HEAD).

assets.what: { files, add, del, lines } for the counter on the diff.
assets.real: Counted from the real diff.patch (rerun stage after deleting it).

assets.what: { project, branch, author, prompt, work[], summary }: what the author typed and the files the agent touched.
assets.stand_in: Maya's prompt from the scrubbed Linkbox session log; files from the pr-tags branch.
assets.real: The demo PR's session: the prompt and git diff --stat.

assets.what: The handover /storydiff writes, typed out line by line.
assets.real: The handover.storydiff /storydiff wrote on the demo PR.

assets.what: The checker's report on that handover; its checks tick in.
assets.stand_in: The real checker (src/check) run on the pr-tags branch with the session log.

assets.what: The same handover with one quote the author never typed.
assets.stand_in: tags.storydiff plus a planted said line.
assets.real: Same, planted on the demo handover.

assets.what: The checker's report on the planted handover; the fake quote fails.
assets.stand_in: The real checker run on handover-fake.storydiff.
assets.real: storydiff check on the planted handover.

assets.what: The PR page with the card as the first comment.
assets.stand_in: scripts/video/pr-page.html with card-tags-bare.png, 1280 CSS px wide.
assets.real: A full-page capture of the demo PR (built-in display only, light theme).

assets.what: { width, scale, card: rect } where the card sits in pr.png.
assets.real: The card image's rect in the captured PR page.

assets.what: The UI + API card, pins drawn.
assets.real: storydiff render --png on the demo PR.

assets.what: The same card with its pins hidden; the film pops the pins in itself.
assets.real: The demo card rendered with .mk,.mki { visibility: hidden }.

assets.what: Where the card's parts sit: parts (asked, verdict, try, before, after, screens, list), items[], pins[] with n and tone.

assets.real: A v1 run on an infra PR.

assets.what: A refactor card (nothing should change, and the proof it didn't).
assets.real: A v1 run on a refactor PR.

assets.what: A big PR card with chapters.
assets.real: A v1 run on a big PR.
